description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git-apply' functionality, particularly its handling of removal patches generated by GNU diff. It sets up various patches and tests applying them in different scenarios to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, used throughout to validate different patch application scenarios.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected, used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files for equality, used to verify patch application results.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file is empty after a patch operation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
